interpretation: On the pinned 100-question Legal RAG Bench retrieval task, plain lexical BM25 retrieves the single gold passage in the top 10 for only 31% of questions. This is expected to stress lexical matching because the benchmark questions were deliberately written to be lexically dissimilar from relevant passages.
claim_boundary: This is an external lexical retrieval component baseline. It is not GitLaw hybrid retrieval, not an end-to-end Legal RAG Bench score, and not German-law legal accuracy.
